resources.string: An outing is a walk with a goal. Start one and keep the phone in your pocket: Passo tells you on the way, with a vibration you can read without looking.
No outings kept. Make one: a goal, a pace, and the signals you want on the way.
Today’s goal is met: nothing left to walk
Signals at %1$s and at the goal
An outing is under way: stop it to start another.
Distances and calories are estimates from your step length. Vibrations follow the phone’s silent mode.
On this phone the step counter cannot wake it: with the screen off, a signal can come a few minutes late.
An outing is measured from your steps: resume counting to start one.
Without the physical activity permission there are no steps to measure an outing with. Today has the way back.
Its signals will not reach you
The outings’ signals are turned off
Android is not showing Passo’s notifications, and the vibrations follow them. The goal reached still shows on Today.
Optional: without one, it is called by its pace.
Minutes in motion: a stop at a traffic light does not count.
Estimated from your steps and your step length.
Every step counts, at any pace.
The steps missing from today’s goal when it starts.
About %1$s and %2$s, with your step of %3$s.
About %1$s and %2$s, with your running step of %3$s.
An estimate: the outing itself is measured from your steps.
On the way at the shares you choose, and always at the goal, which ends the outing.
One short pulse at 25%, two at half, three at 75%, a long one at the goal. They follow the phone’s silent mode.
The outings already walked with it stay in History.
Through headphones only: the start, each signal with what is left and your pace, and the goal. Your music dims for a moment.
Through headphones, or out loud from the phone when it is not on silent.
A voice installed on this phone: Passo sends nothing.
This phone has no offline voice in this language. Install one in the system’s text-to-speech settings: until then the signals are vibrations only.
This phone has no text-to-speech engine: the signals are vibrations only.
